<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Oh no! The <CLT=cltSTRONG>Mass Panic Debate<CLT=cltSYSTEM> is
gonna start! That's what you're thinking, right?

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Welp, you're exactly correct, buddy!
But let me give you another tutorial first.

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>The Mass Panic Debate this time around will
have <CLT=cltSTRONG>Loud Voice Dialogue<CLT=cltSYSTEM>.

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>It's when one of your opponents
shouts their opinion in a <CLT=cltSTRONG>loud voice<CLT=cltSYSTEM>.

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>That blocks out everyone's arguments! Even if
you see a weak spot, you <CLT=cltSTRONG>can't refute it<CLT=cltSYSTEM>.

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Oh no! What do I do then!?
...That's what you're thinking, right?

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Luckily, it's just like <CLT=cltSTRONG>White Noise<CLT=cltSYSTEM>. Shut 'em up
with the <PAD=【○】> button's <CLT=cltSTRONG>silencer<CLT=cltSYSTEM>!

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>After that, all of the arguments
will be <CLT=cltSTRONG>audible again<CLT=cltSYSTEM>.

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Then you just shoot the Truth Bullet at
the Weak Spot. You know the drill.
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Thank you for your understanding.
